model_visible.contract: A client generates one idempotency key when the user taps Bid and reuses that key across HTTP retries. The authoritative sequencer deduplicates before append, and (bidder, idempotency_key) is unique in the same transaction as the event append.
model_visible.implementation_evidence: The client reuses the original key on retries. The server checks and writes the unique bidder/key pair transactionally before append. Duplicate retries return the original accepted result without appending a second bid event.
tests: same request retried three times -> one bid event
same key by same bidder with changed payload -> rejected
different bidder may reuse same opaque key
model_visible.review_task: Identify concrete material defects only. If none are supported by the supplied evidence, report no material defect found.
